covariance: per-window normalized band covariance with epsilon 1e-8
representation: per-band affine log-Euclidean centered logm upper triangle, training-trial reference only
trial_aggregation: mean five window covariances into 8 physical-trial samples
outer_protocol: 4x4 positive-negative trial pairs; 6 train trials / 2 validation trials
inner_protocol: 3x3 positive-negative pairs within outer train; 4 train / 2 validation
standard_scaler: fit on training log-Euclidean features only
